title: Machine Learning & Gen AI

nodes.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning & Generative AI
nodes.subtitle: Linear algebra, matrix operations, probability distributions, multivariate calculus, gradient optimization
learning_objectives: Compute vector dot products and cosine similarity across high-dimensional semantic spaces
Analyze how gradient descent optimizes parameters in non-convex multi-billion-parameter landscapes
feynman_prompts: Why is matrix multiplication the core computational primitive for both neural networks and transformers?
key_misconceptions: Treating neural networks as black boxes without understanding loss gradients and optimization

nodes.title: Classical Machine Learning Foundations
nodes.subtitle: Supervised regression, classification, decision trees, ensemble methods, model evaluation
learning_objectives: Train supervised classification and regression models and evaluate with cross-validation
Select optimal trade-offs between bias and variance using regularization
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental difference between supervised learning (with labels) and unsupervised clustering?
key_misconceptions: Evaluating models on training data alone without held-out validation sets

nodes.title: Deep Learning Mechanics & Neural Optimization
nodes.subtitle: Backpropagation, activation functions (ReLU, GELU), Adam optimizer, LayerNorm, loss surfaces
learning_objectives: Build and train multi-layer neural networks using modern deep learning frameworks
Stabilize deep network training using Layer Normalization and AdamW optimizers
feynman_prompts: How does Layer Normalization stabilize gradient flows during deep transformer training?
key_misconceptions: Using constant high learning rates that cause loss divergence during training

nodes.title: Computer Vision & Sequence Modeling Architectures
nodes.subtitle: CNNs for spatial representations, RNNs/LSTMs for temporal sequence modeling, transfer learning
learning_objectives: Extract visual features using convolutional neural networks and transfer learning
Analyze the limitations of sequential recurrent models that motivated transformer architectures
feynman_prompts: Why do recurrent networks suffer from catastrophic forgetting on long sequence contexts?
key_misconceptions: Attempting to train sequence models from scratch without pre-trained representations

nodes.title: The Transformer Architecture & Attention Deep Dive
nodes.subtitle: Scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, queries/keys/values, positional encodings
learning_objectives: Implement multi-head self-attention mechanisms from mathematical first principles
Explain how self-attention calculates contextual token representations across entire documents in parallel
feynman_prompts: Why does self-attention eliminate the sequential bottleneck inherent in legacy recurrent networks?
key_misconceptions: Assuming attention weights represent absolute factual importance rather than mathematical correlation

nodes.title: Large Language Model Foundations & Pre-training
nodes.subtitle: Causal language modeling, next-token prediction, tokenization (BPE), scaling laws, compute budget
learning_objectives: Explain the autoregressive pre-training objective used by modern frontier LLMs
Apply Chinchilla scaling laws to estimate optimal model size and training tokens for a compute budget
feynman_prompts: What do the Chinchilla scaling laws state regarding the optimal balance between parameters and tokens?
key_misconceptions: Assuming LLMs understand reality rather than predicting the most statistically probable next token

nodes.title: Tokenization, Vector Embeddings & Semantic Spaces
nodes.subtitle: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE), subwords, dense embedding models, vector dimensions, cosine distance
learning_objectives: Tokenize arbitrary text using Byte-Pair Encoding and diagnose tokenization edge cases
Generate dense vector embeddings to represent semantic concepts in high-dimensional vector spaces
feynman_prompts: Why do subword tokenizers handle previously unseen vocabulary without out-of-vocabulary crashes?
key_misconceptions: Confusing string character length with token count, leading to context window overflows

nodes.title: Systematic Prompt Engineering & Reasoning Scaffolds
nodes.subtitle: System prompts, Few-Shot prompting, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), output formatting, prompt injection
learning_objectives: Author robust system prompts that elicit deterministic structured outputs from LLMs
Improve multi-step logical reasoning accuracy using Few-Shot and Chain-of-Thought techniques
feynman_prompts: Why does Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting drastically improve complex multi-step reasoning?
key_misconceptions: Concatenating untrusted user input directly into system prompts without injection guards

nodes.title: Vector Databases & Semantic Search Engines
nodes.subtitle: pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN), HNSW indexing, metadata filtering
learning_objectives: Deploy scalable vector databases and configure HNSW index parameters for sub-50ms search
Execute filtered semantic similarity searches combining vector distance with relational metadata
feynman_prompts: How does HNSW enable sub-linear Approximate Nearest Neighbor search across millions of vectors?
key_misconceptions: Running brute-force exact vector distance scans in production without vector indexing

nodes.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Document chunking (semantic/recursive), dense vs sparse retrieval, hybrid search (BM25 + vector)
learning_objectives: Build production RAG pipelines that ground LLM answers in verified private enterprise knowledge
Implement hybrid search combining dense semantic vectors with sparse BM25 keyword matching
feynman_prompts: Why does hybrid search (dense + sparse) solve the specific vocabulary and product code problem in RAG?
key_misconceptions: Using arbitrary fixed chunk sizes that cut critical sentences and code blocks in half

nodes.title: Advanced RAG: Query Expansion, HyDE & Reranking
nodes.subtitle: Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE), Cross-Encoder reranking, multi-query expansion
learning_objectives: Re-rank retrieved context documents using high-precision Cross-Encoder models before prompting
Expand ambiguous user questions using Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE)
feynman_prompts: How does Cross-Encoder reranking improve RAG retrieval precision over bi-encoder cosine search alone?
key_misconceptions: Passing 50 irrelevant retrieved context documents into the LLM context, diluting answer quality

nodes.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT & LoRA)
nodes.subtitle: Full fine-tuning vs PEFT, LoRA rank decomposition, QLoRA 4-bit quantization, dataset prep
learning_objectives: Fine-tune open-weights models (Llama 3, Mistral) on domain instruction datasets using QLoRA
Decide objectively when to apply RAG (dynamic knowledge) vs Fine-Tuning (style, format, task)
feynman_prompts: Why does LoRA freeze base model weights and only train low-rank adapter matrices?
key_misconceptions: Attempting to use fine-tuning to teach models frequently changing factual information

nodes.title: Model Alignment: RLHF & Direct Preference Optimization
nodes.subtitle: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reward Modeling, PPO, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
learning_objectives: Align generative models with human preferences using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
Structure pairwise preference datasets (chosen vs rejected responses) for alignment training
feynman_prompts: Why is Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) significantly simpler and more stable to train than PPO?
key_misconceptions: Assuming that pre-trained base language models are safe and ready for conversational users without alignment

nodes.title: Autonomous AI Agents & Tool Execution Frameworks
nodes.subtitle: Function calling, ReAct pattern (Reason + Act), tool schemas, multi-step planning, error recovery
learning_objectives: Build autonomous AI agents that reason, call external APIs, evaluate results, and solve multi-step tasks
Enforce strict JSON schema validation on tool arguments to prevent runtime execution failures
feynman_prompts: How does the ReAct framework enable models to self-correct when an API tool call returns an error?
key_misconceptions: Granting AI agents unconstrained destructive write permissions without human-in-the-loop safeguards

nodes.title: Multimodal Generative AI: Vision-Language Models
nodes.subtitle: Vision-Language Models (VLMs), image patch projection, CLIP embeddings, document visual reasoning
learning_objectives: Process and reason over multimodal inputs (images, diagrams, UI wireframes) using frontier VLMs
Analyze how vision transformers project image patches into the same semantic space as text tokens
feynman_prompts: How do Vision-Language Models convert 2D image patches into visual tokens for the transformer?
key_misconceptions: Relying exclusively on OCR text extraction when visual document layout contains critical context

nodes.title: AI Evaluation Frameworks & Hallucination Auditing
nodes.subtitle: Ragas evaluation, Faithfulness, Context Precision, LLM-as-a-Judge, automated regression suites
learning_objectives: Implement automated evaluation pipelines quantifying RAG faithfulness and hallucination rates
Design calibrated multi-criteria rubrics for automated LLM-as-a-Judge assessment suites
feynman_prompts: What is Faithfulness in RAG evaluation and how does it verify that claims are grounded in context?
key_misconceptions: Evaluating enterprise AI applications based on subjective impressions rather than rigorous automated benchmarks

nodes.title: AI Safety, Guardrails & Adversarial Robustness
nodes.subtitle: NeMo Guardrails, prompt injection mitigation, jailbreak defense, PII masking, automated red teaming
learning_objectives: Implement input/output guardrails to detect and block prompt injection attacks and toxic outputs
Conduct systematic red teaming to identify adversarial jailbreak vulnerabilities in AI applications
feynman_prompts: How do indirect prompt injection attacks exploit AI applications that process external web content?
key_misconceptions: Assuming that prompt instructions alone are sufficient to defend against adversarial injection attacks

nodes.title: Production LLM Serving & Performance Optimization
nodes.subtitle: vLLM, continuous batching, PagedAttention, quantization (AWQ/GGUF), semantic caching, cost controls
learning_objectives: Deploy high-throughput open-source LLM inference servers using vLLM and continuous batching
Implement semantic caching and model routing to slash API token expenses by 60%
feynman_prompts: How does PagedAttention eliminate memory fragmentation in GPU VRAM during concurrent inference?
key_misconceptions: Deploying LLMs using basic sequential Python loops that handle only one user query at a time

description: Master Machine Learning & Gen AI with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
